value.rationale: This is a complete natural two-parameter family classification, including four exact regimes, sharp smallest representatives, and the nontrivial effect that triangle-free graphs of unbounded chromatic number are all three-round equivalent to the Petersen graph. The thresholds correspond to precisely when common neighbors become available for adjacent and nonadjacent pairs and therefore expose a structural logical blindness; this is broader than tabulating arbitrary small examples.
